name: Terminal
description: The person's shell in a pseudo-terminal the core runs: several terminals on one surface, with the desk's theme, keys and buffers.

commands.title: Run a program in a new terminal

endue.terminal.shell.description: The program a new terminal runs: a name on PATH or a path. Empty: zsh, bash or sh on macOS and Linux (whichever is there first), pwsh, powershell or cmd on Windows. A program outside the plugin's grants is asked for once.

endue.terminal.args.description: Arguments for the shell, after its own.

endue.terminal.login.description: Start zsh, bash, fish and sh as login shells (-l). auto: yes on macOS, no elsewhere.

endue.terminal.cwd.description: Where a new terminal starts: a rooted path (~, /, ${home}).

endue.terminal.env.description: Extra environment variables for every terminal, over TERM, COLORTERM and TERM_PROGRAM.

endue.terminal.scrollback.description: Lines kept above the screen, per terminal (0 to 100000).

endue.terminal.font-family.description: The terminal's font. Empty: the platform's monospace font.

endue.terminal.font-size.description: The font size in pixels (8 to 40).

endue.terminal.cursor-blink.description: Whether the cursor blinks. Reduced motion stops it either way.

endue.terminal.bell.description: What the terminal bell does: a desk notification, or nothing.

endue.terminal.copy-on-select.description: Copy text as soon as it is selected.

endue.terminal.keys-to-desk.description: Chords the terminal hands to the desk instead of the shell, over the desk's own (its palette, buffer, window and desktop keys), like Control+Q.
